text:
alex: Observed a 30-40% p95 latency bump for seqlen 384 paths after the driver and model roll this morning.
priya: saw it too. looks seqlen-specific; seqlen 64/128 unaffected. any canary metrics? :thinking:
mike: canary shows kernel_selector switched to fallback kernel on aarch64 nodes. maybe wrong kernel heuristic.
alex: profiling dump attached: 
```
# top kernel times for request batch
arch=aarch64 model=rwkv-seq2 seq=384
kernel_fast_attention: 12ms
kernel_generic_attention: 45ms
```
jordan: that gap is huge. why did selector pick generic for 384? selector uses seqlen bins + arch weight. maybe bin boundary off.
priya: also noticed KV cache miss rate spiked ~200% at the same time. suspect key namespace changed on driver handshake during rollout.
sam: +1, logs show model_version token changed from "v12" -> "v12+driver-202" which would salt keys implicitly.
alex: here's current key format in code snippet:
```
// cache key
key = fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%d|%d", model_name, model_version, session_id, prefix_hash)
```
mike: driver auto-suffixing model_version is the culprit. keys weren't persisted across driver update, so cache cold starts and selector falls back to generic kernel due to no KV cache speedup.
priya: quick mitigation: don't include driver build in model_version used for keying. introduce model_runtime_id separate from model_version.
jordan: we should also persist a mapping across rollouts: allow key rehydration if model binary is semantically identical. add a translational map in storage.
sam: perf patch idea: change selector to consider historical kernel performance per (model_name, session_bin) and ignore transient key misses for first N mins. avoid flipping to generic kernel on cold cache.
alex: agreed. plan:
- hotfix: revert model_version suffixing in driver config (ops)
- code: introduce stable_cache_id (model_name + stable_model_hash) for KV keys (priya)
- selector: implement warm-tolerant heuristic (mike)
- ops: canary rollout with 2% traffic to validate (jordan)

priya: writing quick patch for key format, will open PR with tests.
mike: I'll sketch selector change: keep last_seen_perf for kernel candidates and require 3 consecutive misses before switching.
jordan: can we add telemetry: kernel_switch_reason tag + kv_miss_rate correlation? need for postmortem.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: build/driver-rollback-2256789 started by @ops
sam: small note: persistence layer TTL was 7 days for ephemeral cache. consider extending to 14 for slower rollouts.
alex: thanks team. let's sync in 30m to review PR and canary metrics. :thumbsup:
priya: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/rwkv/stable-cache-id
mike: test run locally shows p95 back to baseline on aarch64 after key fix and selector tweak.
jordan: will monitor canary. posting snapshots in #eng-runtime.
alex: closing thread for now, reopen if things regress.
